In a historic building on the Grand Canal, a stone's throw from the Rialto bridge, the Duodo is a luxurious penthouse loft equipped with every comfort.

The “water gate” allows those who want to arrive by taxi to access the building directly from the Grand Canal, while the elevator allows to access the attic with only one flight of stairs.

The “altana”, the traditional panoramic roof-top terrace, is furnished with wooden table and chairs, deckchair and awning for the hottest days.

It is found at the 4th and 5th floor with elevator of a historic building long time owned by the same family who completely renovated it and finally offered to our privileged guests in 2018 for the first time.

With a short walk you can reach the La Fenice theatre, Piazza S. Marco and the Rialto bridge.
The structure is easily reachable either on foot from Piazzale Roma or by using the vaporetti which arrive at the two nearby stops of Accademia and Zattere.

description: The boat is moored in the heart of Venice at Lamarina Sant'Elena, a dream marina, in the historic center of Venice, behind the Biennale and a few hundred meters from Piazza San Marco.A few steps from the Castello district, center of the Venetian nightlife, away from the crowds and common itineraries, you can savor the most original and popular Venice among baccari and typical restaurants.Daily custom cruise to the islands and sea food lunch are available at special price for our guests.

name: San Bortolo
description:
The San Bortolo is a bright, airy and recently restored apartment strategically located at the foot of the Rialto Bridge in the oldest part of the historic town.

It is found at the crossroad of the most important artistic and cultural itineraries, right behind the statue of Carlo Goldoni in Campo San Bartolomeo, the classic meeting place for local Venetians.

Simply step out home and find a multitude of cafés, restaurants, osterie and bacari scattered in the nearby streets.

name: Canaletto
description:
Brand new, very bright and trendy, the Canaletto apartment offers a stunning canal view and great comfort in the best spot of Castello district.
San Marco Square and the Rialto Bridge can be reached in only 5 minutes’ walk: the location is absolutely central. This is one of our favourite areas of Venice historical centre, close to the main tourist attractions but still very quiet and well serviced by local shops and restaurants as well as supermarkets.

name: Alcova Terrace
description:
The Alcova is a very bright and quiet apartment located along the Arsenale Canal in the Castello District with a lovely panoramic terrace.
This area of the Castello District is now in high demand between connoisseurs, artists and true Venetians because of its genuineness and antique historical heritage.
This is the oldest part of the city, where everything started more than a millennium ago and still today it is preserved almost integrally.

name: Loredan
description:
The Loredan is a sophisticated Venetian house on three levels with a truly charming private courtyard located in a quiet street of the Dorsoduro District.

It is a unique home: spacious, full of natural light, furnished with precious antiques, fabrics and objects belonging to Owner’s family for centuries.

The living room is divided from the private courtyard only by two ancient marble columns and a glass wall, conferring the feeling of a large open-air living room.

The Manin is a welcoming apartment with stunning views on Campo Santo Stefano, one of the nicest locations of the historic centre, few steps from the famous Accademia Bridge, in the San Marco District.

It is found at the 2nd floor of an historic Palazzo, it is accessible directly from the square, it has been recently renovated to the highest standards and finally offered to our privileged guests.

A comfortable accommodation, ideal for the whole family, from which to enjoy the most spectacular views of the San Marco basin. Discover the real Venice, away from the crowds, and experience every moment in complete relaxation.

The Fenice Theatre is known by the connoisseurs to be one of the best Opera Houses in the world. There are plenty of classy restaurants, cafés and boutiques in the surroundings.

Many connoisseurs of Venice and influential artists have homes in this area as it is picturesque, culturally interesting and quiet.

It is a great property for those who are looking for quietness and comfort in a classy environment, with outdoor space.

Campo San Barnaba is considered the best location of the Dorsoduro District by locals as it is close to both public transport and every sort of shop, while offering easy access to the most important landmarks of the historic center.

The house (70sqm)is arranged on 3 levels: kitchen and bathroom on the ground floor. Living area and night on the 1st floor. On the 2nd floor a warm and enveloping attic where you can take refuge with a good book and relax.

Magnificent terrace of about 30 meters (shared with the apartment next door called "Glicine" but with 2 reserved tables).
